notes.title: Go! Birdie Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39305510/3c88e11c46f77ccd002e2859cf8697144f1e1594.png[/img]

In version 1.1 we changed:

[list]
[*] Skins for player's character are now unlocking correctly.
[*] Save file won't be deleted after game is uninstalled.
[*] New opportunities to gain points added.
[*] Some levels were too difficult, they are easier to finish now.
[*] Indestructible blocks dissapear now to prevent blocking player in lvl.
[/list]
